product_metadata.title: Giftgarden Brown 4x6 Picture Frame Set of 4, 5x7 Frame Matted to 4x6 Photo Rustic Walnut Frames with Mat for Wall or Tabletop Display
features: Pretty Walnut-color Frames: Come in a set of 4 4x6 frames with mat to your 4x6 inch pictures, photos, postcards. These nut-brown 4x6 picture frames have a classy look to whatever you are displaying.

Multiple Way of Display: These 4x6 matted picture frames have metal hanging parts and clips on the back to hang vertically or horizontally, freestanding on table top. If taking the matting, they are frames for 5x7 picture also.
Easy to Use: The 4 by 6 frames include the hanging hardware and easel, it is easy for you to take apart, put in picture and close up, which does not require an expert to set it up.
Sturdy Frame: Constructed of quality PS resin which let the frames have thick frame sides and make them sturdy. The clear glass fronts are safely lightweight.
Nice Decor and Gift Choice: These cute dark brown 4 x 6 picture frames fit any interior decoration. Great for clusters of family pictures and friend photos, makes an ideal gift.
